author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be some good signs for not just our gaming but maybe even our future in general. The biggest companies are on edge after some startling changes and the free ride that has enabled the largest AI companies to chew up every bit of compute in the world might be coming to a possible close. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: The World Is Starting To Heal...
